title: Find bookable McDonald's parties in China with an agent
summary: Developer johnny37 built an agent add-on using McDonald's China's official agent connector to find bookable parties and kids' events, reporting 3,664 stores across 281 cities.
agent_role: When loaded as a skill, the agent chains five read-only MCP tools to find cities, stores, dates, sessions and prices for an event. Separate scripts collect the data for the map, and real bookings are off by default behind an exact-phrase human confirmation.
outcome: Author reports a 2026-10-13 snapshot covering 281 cities, 3,664 stores and 157 sampled sessions, with 98 offline tests passing.
what_they_did: Developer johnny37 used McDonald's China's official connector for agents to collect where events can be booked. These include birthday parties, themed parties, tastings and kids' reading clubs. The data feeds a simple map. The project also lets an agent answer questions like 'can I book a birthday party in Chengdu this Saturday?' It checks the rewards shop, then city, store, date and time slot.
how_it_went: The author reports a snapshot from 2026-10-13: 3,664 bookable stores in 281 cities, a typical 18 event types per city, and 98 automatic checks passing. Two listed events can't be booked anywhere. For Chengdu, the agent listed time slots and open spots, noting the price shown was for a different event type.
worth_knowing: The booking steps aren't written down anywhere and start in the rewards shop. Replies mix formatted text with raw data and need careful reading. Tools that place orders are blocked and never retried, because a retry could create a duplicate paid order.
prompt: Using the McDonald's China MCP tools (read-only), find where I can book a [birthday party / reading club / tasting] in [your city] on [date]. Follow the chain: list experience products, then the cities that offer the one I pick, then stores, available dates and sessions. Show store names, session times, remaining slots, group-size rules and the price per person. Prices come back in fen, so convert them to yuan. Do not call any order-creation tool. I will book in the app myself.

curation.rationale: A working agent skill that chains McDonald's China MCP tools to answer booking-availability questions, with code, tests and a live map. It is close in concept to an earlier Beijing-only McDonald's events entry, so it gets less credit for originality.
